title: Enterprise Connectivity: authoritative reviewed amount
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this authoritative reviewed amount rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: reviewed
For net transfer invoice, read net service subtotal only from the exact selected assessment with source classification primary, source-event reference equal to selected export bundle, status approved and decision correct; pending or rejected reviews and every other assessment contribute zero. For this qualifying assisted on-demand source, the exact approved assessment under the accepted-source pricing assessment is the authoritative discounted net input, independently of undiscounted monthly portfolio usage subtotal and portfolio spending threshold; do not reselect its price using ordinary portfolio eligibility or price precedence at invoice issuance. Its assisted fraction applies only to primary net service usage and gives no cash credit or reduction of ancillary fees or tax.
